mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the rate crossing above 4.5%, or the 20d returns are not significantly different from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in the federal funds rate and increases in GDP (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand growth, amplifying equity valuation expansion and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous value AND GDPC1 > previous value
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in instances where both proxies meet the trigger condition (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high GDP growth (GDPC1) and elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE), investor sentiment shifts toward risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where the regime condition (GDPC1 > 100 AND UNRATE > 4%) is met, the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or the IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO index signals expanding production capacity and healthy supply dynamics, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns in supply expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or IC < 0.03 over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rates above 4% signals labor market tightness and potential inflationary pressures, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly negative in > 60% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the IC > 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Both rising GDP (GDPC1) and increasing production (INDPRO) indicate overcapacity and muted growth prospects, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous value AND INDPRO > previous value
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly negative in > 60% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the IC > 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime marked by rising federal funds rates and sustained GDP growth (GDPC1), investors anticipate prolonged expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous value AND GDPC1 > previous value
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive in > 60% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the IC < 0.03 over the horizon.
